spec.requirements:
# Requirements: Replace request with native fetch

## Context

- Deprecated: "request has been deprecated, see https://github.com/request/request/issues/3142" (npm.version.deprecated)
- No publish in 6 years (last 2020-02-11) (deps.dev.versions[isDefault].publishedAt)
- 1 known vulnerability in 2.88.2 (GHSA-p8p7-x288-28g6) (osv.querybatch.results[].vulns[].id)
- OpenSSF Scorecard 3.6/10 (scorecard.score)
- Successor: native fetch. request was deprecated in 2020; fetch ships in Node 18+ (curated.successors[request])

Scope: 3 source files scanned, 2 need changes.

## User stories

- As a maintainer, I want to stop depending on `request` so that I no longer ship an unmaintained dependency.
- As a reviewer, I want proof that behaviour is unchanged so that I can merge with confidence.

## Acceptance criteria (EARS)

- R1.1 WHEN the migration patch is applied THE SYSTEM SHALL contain no import or require of `request` in the 2 migrated files.
- R1.2 WHEN `package.json` is read THE SYSTEM SHALL no longer list `request` as a dependency, unless unmigrated usage remains.
- R2.1 WHEN the differential property-based tests run THE SYSTEM SHALL show identical observable behaviour between `request` and native fetch (request-compat shim) for the covered operations over at least 100 generated inputs each.
- R2.2 IF a call site uses behaviour the recipe cannot express THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL leave a `TODO(revenant)` comment and list it in the migration notes instead of silently changing it.
- R3.1 WHERE the project's own test suite exists THE SYSTEM SHALL pass it unchanged after the migration.
spec.design:
# Design: Replace request with native fetch

## Approach

Apply the curated `request-to-fetch` recipe: a deterministic source transform, a `package.json` edit, and 1 added file(s) (lib/request-compat.cjs). Verification is differential: the old and new implementations run side by side under fast-check.

## Flow

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Scan: request@2.88.2 flagged] --> B[Recipe request-to-fetch]
  B --> C[Patch: 2 files]
  B --> D[Differential PBT]
  C --> E{Tests green?}
  D --> E
  E -- yes --> F[Open PR]
  E -- no --> G[Review TODO notes]
```

## Known limits

- The shim covers the common callback API: uri/url, method, qs, headers, body, json, form, auth, timeout, followRedirect, encoding: null, plus get/post/put/patch/del/head/defaults.
- Streams and .pipe(), cookie jars, multipart, proxies and nested qs objects are not supported; call sites are flagged with TODOs.
- Differential tests run both clients against a local HTTP server; they do not cover TLS, redirects across hosts or retry behaviour.

## Files changed

- `src/notify.js`
- `src/server.js`
- `lib/request-compat.cjs` (new)
